deleteflagversion.scope: Deletes named calibration snapshots in caller order. Empty lists and missing names are no-ops. The main table stays intact.

done.scope: Releases the calibration attachment and clears queued and initialized agents. Repeated calls succeed.

getflagversionlist.scope: Returns the original table header, main entry and ordered raw calibration version names and comments. The print switch controls logging.

init.scope: Initializes compatible queued agents once a calibration table has a global selection. Retains initialized agents and leaves incompatible configurations out of execution.

open.scope: Attaches current-format CPARAM and FPARAM calibration tables and resets global selection and agent state. MeasurementSet attachment is tracked in #978.

parseagentparameters.scope: Accepts native calibration agent records, including manual, unflag, clip, quack, summary, extend, TFCrop and RFlag plus CASA parser and initialization refusals.

parseantintparameters.scope: Queues the specialized antenna-integration configuration. A raw configuration with a physical calibration column raises safely during execution where CASA aborts.

parseclipparameters.scope: Queues clipping of physical calibration values with row, channel and solution-plane selection, range and zero handling, averaging compatibility and flag or unflag action.

parseelevationparameters.scope: Accepts the specialized elevation configuration and matches CASA’s deferred refusal on calibration tables.

parseextendparameters.scope: Queues calibration flag extension across time, channel and solution planes, with configured neighbor rules, growth percentages and flag or unflag action.

parsemanualparameters.scope: Queues flag or unflag for selected calibration rows and channels, with autocorrelation and time controls.

parsequackparameters.scope: Queues flagging or unflagging at scan boundaries with the CASA interval, edge and increment options.

parsesummaryparameters.scope: Queues staged flag statistics for calibration rows, windows and channels with the requested breakdowns and report name.

parsetfcropparameters.scope: Queues time and frequency fits against stored calibration values, with the native fit and window controls, averaging validation and action. An explicitly empty correlation selects the first solution plane.

printflagselection.scope: Logs the active calibration selection and returns the tool’s Boolean result.

restoreflagversion.scope: Restores requested versions in order with replace, OR and AND semantics. Earlier successful restores persist when a later name is missing.

run.scope: Consumes initialized agents with sequential or combined ordering. Dry runs keep staged results in reports. Each RFlag agent separately controls threshold calculation.

saveflagversion.scope: Snapshots the original calibration flags through the casacore read lock. Supports raw names, comments, merge modes and the empty-name flags. version.

selectdata.scope: Replaces global calibration row selection. A nonempty config record takes precedence over keyword selectors. Agents can choose their own channel selection.

signature.scope: All 19 installed CASA methods, parameter order and effective defaults per method.

calibration-casa.scope: Current complex and real calibration tables, selection, lifecycle, flag masks, reports, mixed averaging, raw version operations and safe refusal controls.
